feeds.title: Mamme Creative
feeds.description: MammeCreative.it is a community of mothers who talks to mothers, share direct experiences without being above the parties, tell about motherhood in its true essence not limiting itself to highlighting the positive aspects, but also focusing on the difficulties of being a parent.

feeds.title: Nonsolomamma
feeds.description: I am Claudia. I have three kids, a big one of 17, a middle one of 14 and a small one of 11, and a part-time husband because a lot of his time is in London or in the middle of nowhere in Massachusetts.

feeds.title: Supermamma
feeds.description: I'm Angela Ercolano, blogger, and coach of companies and freelancers. If you have a business I help you to take your business from offline to online.In 2015 I became a freelance web coach. Thanks to my courses I help you to put your business online.

feeds.title: BabyGreen
feeds.description: BabyGreen is the site for green families: recipes, cooking, home, games, travel, books, Montessori. A blog for green mothers, Since 2010.

feeds.title: Mammafelice
feeds.description: Mammafelice's website, for creative mothers: games for children, DIY, sewing, craft, creativity, pregnancy, recipes, Montessori, happy thoughts, and more.

feeds.title: Mamme a Spillo
feeds.description: Mamme a Spillo was born from an idea of Valentina Piccini, an art historian and mother of four children, an expert in communication, and above all a lover of writing and the world of fashion. Today Mamme a Spillo has become a reference point for the world of fashion aimed at mothers and children.

feeds.title: Federchicca Blog
feeds.description: I am Federica. I am a consultant and lecturer on Influencer Marketing. Social Advisor and Blogger since 2008. I have been writing about travel since 2008.

feeds.title: Ricomincio da quattro
feeds.description: My name is Adriana, I have four children, from zero to adolescence, a partner, an organic farm, and a blog. In my blog, I tell you about me and my world. I write about what I like: photos, videos, fashion, travel, cooking, baby, and more.

feeds.title: Mamme Acrobate Blog
feeds.description: Moms Acrobates is a site for moms and dads about motherhood, parenting, children, education, school, work, law, home, shopping, travel and more.

feeds.title: Eleonora Laurito
feeds.description: I am Eleonora - Alisea's mother and Roberto Valbuzzi's wife. I work with my husband between the family restaurant, Crotto Valtellina in Malnate, catering, events and TV. Since 2020, I have this blog, where I tell about our daily life.

feeds.title: Trend a Porter
feeds.description: Lifestyle and family blog by Sara and Simona Aiello. All the advice on styles, trends, mothers, babies, fashion, and travel in one click!

feeds.title: Just4Mom
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Laura, a mother like many others, in constant struggle against time. I share with you the joys and sorrows of what is certainly the most incredible experience in the world: motherhood!

feeds.title: Una mamma green
feeds.description: A blog for mothers always looking for them and their families. A blog for mothers who travel, work and love. Free from conditioning and in contact with one's authentic instinct.

feeds.title: 50 Shades of Mom
feeds.description: 3 women, 3 mothers who decided to start a blog, in 2012, to talk about motherhood in light and ironic way.

feeds.title: Casa Organizzata
feeds.description: Casa Organizzata is a project by Alessia Gribaudi Tramontana , author, blogger, Social Media Specialist. I write about creativity, family, children, organization, food, work, ecology and recycling, books, natural medicine, pregnancy, animals and many other topics that are always based on my being a woman, a mother and a freelance worker.

feeds.title: Claudia Porta
feeds.description: I'm Claudia Porta, author, blogger, yoga and meditation teacher. I live in Provence and I am the mother of Leonardo, Gloria and Chiara.

feeds.title: Francesca Di Meglio
feeds.description: I am the Italian Mamma, and I welcome you to la famiglia. I can help you navigate family travel, food, and fun with the ultimate goal of helping you make beautiful memories with your loved ones. A mother of two young boys and an Italian American, who married an Italian.

feeds.title: Brigida Abbruzzese
feeds.description: I am Brigida. I was born on August 26, 1984.Mother of two wonderful children, Riccardo with thick red hair and Carmen with her big doe eyes.Wife of Giuseppe, an extraordinary man who shares with me the passion for DIY.

feeds.title: Mum is the CEO
feeds.description: My name is Benedetta for friends Bebbe, mother of Bibbi and Chicca, wife of Antonello. I am a lawyer who does not work as a lawyer because she has chosen to be a full-time mother.

feeds.title: Mamma Imperfetta
feeds.description: I live in Reggio Emilia, I have a degree in Philosophy and I am a journalist and digital marketing manager.Writing is my passion, I've been doing it since I learned how to do it. I made it a profession, a hobby, a lesson, a solution.

feeds.title: Mammarketing
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Daniela, journalist and digital storyteller. Always nerd and creative. I like to find the hope to do everything I love. I'm a mom! of two children and of this blog.

feeds.title: Irenesofia.it
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Irene! I am a dog trainer and behavioral rehabilitator, biologist, mom, blogger and YouTuber. Today I take care of helping dogs and owners to live together peacefully.

feeds.title: Sweet as a Candy
feeds.description: Founded in 2009 by Federica Piccinini and born as an inspirational blog, over the years it has grown to become a digital lifestyle magazine. A reference point for design, fashion, beauty, and kids world in the unmistakable Sweet as a Candy style.

feeds.title: Periodo Fertile
feeds.description: Periodo Fertile guides you and helps you from conception to pregnancy and the baby's early years. It was born in 2007 from the intuition of Elena Crestanello, biologist and mother, as a portal dedicated to motherhood in all its aspects.

feeds.title: FamigliaI Nviaggio
feeds.description: Ideas and proposals on holidays with children: itineraries, what and where to eat, what to visit, to travel with the family. We are Fabio, Michela and two children (a 7 year old boy and a 4 year old girl).
